scientific_integrity: Proof is a finite exhaustive exact computation over all 32767 nonzero quartic forms, using complete GL3(F2) orbit enumeration and exact Groebner geometric smoothness tests; direct independent evaluation of all 10920 smooth coefficient vectors checks incidence. No extrapolation from samples or claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact coefficient and projective-orbit census for smooth plane quartics over F2 only. Earlier complete quartic classifications could yield the incidence distribution after supplementary calculations; unindexed antecedent computations remain possible. Independent mathematical audit and validation have not been performed.
title: Tangent filling and blocking among smooth binary plane quartics
